description:
## What

Implement `ZlintBridge::enumerate_lints() -> Result<Vec<ZlintLintInfo>, BridgeError>` against `zlint -list-lints-json`.

zlint emits one JSON object per line: `{"name", "description", "citation", "source"}`. The bridge:

1. Spawns `<zlint_path> -list-lints-json` once per call
2. Reads stdout as NDJSON (line-delimited)
3. Maps each line into `ZlintLintInfo`
4. Derives `severity` from the check name prefix per zlint convention: `e_` -> `Severity::Error`, `w_` -> `Severity::Warn`, `n_` -> `Severity::Notice`, anything else -> `BridgeError::OutputParseError` (defensive — zlint catalog hygiene says all checks have one of those three prefixes)
5. Returns the populated `Vec`

## Surface

`impl ZlintBridge { pub fn enumerate_lints(&self) -> Result<Vec<ZlintLintInfo>, BridgeError>; }`

## Implementation notes

- Subprocess timeout: applies. Use `BridgeConfig::timeout`.
- Subprocess failure modes: `BinaryNotFound` (io::ErrorKind::NotFound), `SubprocessTimeout` (kill on deadline), `SubprocessFailed` (non-zero exit), `OutputParseError` (malformed JSON line or unrecognized severity prefix).
- Encoding: zlint emits UTF-8.
- Empty stdout is `OutputParseError` (zlint always emits at least one line).

## Tests

- Integration test invokes zlint via the bridge against the real binary. Asserts:
  - Returned `Vec` is non-empty (zlint ships ~400 lints).
  - Every entry has a non-empty `check_id`.
  - At least one entry each with severity `Error`, `Warn`, `Notice` (zlint catalog hygiene; if zlint upstream changes this we want to know).
  - Specific known-good entry pinned: `e_basic_constraints_not_critical` exists with source `RFC5280` (or wherever zlint puts it; verify against `zlint -list-lints-json | grep`).
- Unit test for the severity-derivation helper against synthetic name strings (`e_x`, `w_y`, `n_z`, malformed `q_x`).

## Acceptance

- [ ] `enumerate_lints()` implementation in `pkix-zlint-bridge/src/lib.rs`
- [ ] Severity derivation helper covered by unit tests with positive + malformed inputs
- [ ] Integration test invokes real zlint and pins catalog shape
- [ ] cargo build / clippy --all-features -D warnings / fmt --check / doc --no-deps clean
- [ ] CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased citing PKIX-jy95.7.2

## Out of scope

- `run_on_cert` / `run_on_certs` (PKIX-jy95.7.3 / .7.4)
- Caching enumerate_lints output across calls (the catalog is static; one call per bridge instance per session is acceptable)

## Cross-references

- PKIX-jy95.7.1 (scaffold; types this implementation populates)
- PKIX-jy95.1 (runtime-enumerated lint granularity decision)
- PKIX-jy95.2 (severity mapping decision; zlint catalog severity flow)
